entries.en: The council approved a balanced budget for the coming year.
entries.zh: 市议会通过了来年的平衡预算。

entries.en: Steel baling wire held the compressed hay together.
entries.zh: 打包钢丝把压紧的干草捆在一起。

entries.en: A ball-peen hammer lay beside the metalworking vise.
entries.zh: 一把圆头锤放在金属加工台钳旁。

entries.en: The ballistic galvanometer measured charge from a brief current pulse.
entries.zh: 冲击电流计测量了短暂电流脉冲带来的电荷。

entries.en: The museum displayed a deactivated ballistic missile.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚已停用的弹道飞弹。

entries.en: The model shows a projectile striking the ballistic pendulum.
entries.zh: 模型显示一个抛射体撞击冲击摆。

entries.en: My ballpoint pen left a blue mark on the receipt.
entries.zh: 我的圆珠笔在收据上留下了一道蓝色痕迹。
